assets.name: fx-slash.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original interface asset for Breachline, a high-fantasy card game played on a linen war map stretched over a weathered oak camp table, lit by one warm lamp. The interface is made of real objects a field commander would have on that table: blackened iron, worn brass, gold leaf, wax, silk, parchment and ink.
Paint it in the same hand as the game's traditional oil and acrylic fantasy paintings: visible but quiet brushwork, believable materials, precise rather than noisy detail. Never a photograph, 3D render, vector art, flat icon, emoji or cartoon. Evenly lit from the upper left. Match brush scale to local detail; diffuse surfaces for cloth, wood and paper, selective metal reflections.
Output one 1536 x 1024 landscape PNG with true alpha transparency. Paint only the object or effect itself: no table, cloth, map, hands or scenery unless specifically requested. No text, letters, numbers, runes, logos, watermarks or signatures. Blank areas stay plain and smooth so the game can write on them. All empty pixels genuinely transparent, no painted checkerboard or background color.
EXACT 1536 x 1024 PNG sprite sheet of six square animation frames, each 512 x 512, in two rows of three with no gaps, borders, labels or dividing lines. Read the frames left to right along the top row, then the bottom row. These are six moments of ONE continuous impact at each frame centre, first contact in frame 1, greatest force in frame 2, outward development in frames 3 and 4, fading in frame 5, last faint traces in frame 6. Keep the effect centred, at the same scale and in the same light. Local cell centres (256,256); absolute centres (256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Confine all paint, sparks and haze to the inner 400 x 400 pixels of each cell: at least 56 entirely transparent pixels at every cell edge. Partly transparent painted effect edges, not background haze. No effect may touch or cross its frame edge. No weapons, people, cards or scenery. The game adds shake, flash and damage numbers.
A blade strike. A bright curved arc of cut air sweeps from the left of each frame to the right, with a scatter of steel sparks and a few torn threads of cloth flung along its path. Warm white at the arc's edge, pale gold sparks, no blood. Frame 1 a small curved first-contact glint at centre, frame 2 broad bright arc, frame 3 arc sweeps right with sparks, frame 4 thin breaking arc, frame 5 a few fine fading sparks and cloth threads, frame 6 only two or three faint traces. Painted physical substance with controlled bloom; no weapon or visible target.
assets.extraction_note: Use explicit source_rect_xyxy; static object spacing is not always an equal grid. Rectangles include 12px padding around alpha>8 content. Original low-alpha pixels are preserved. For FX, always use fixed 512px frames.
